search_jobs.description: Search a company's Greenhouse job board for a keyword or phrase. Matches the job title, location, department and office names, and the full description (case-insensitive), with an optional location filter. Returns the matching posts without their descriptions; fetch one with 'Get Greenhouse job' once you know which post you want.
search_jobs.name: search_jobs

parameters.description: The company's Greenhouse job board token, the last path segment of its board URL (e.g. 'anthropic' in https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic). Pasting the board or job post URL works too.
parameters.name: board_token

parameters.description: The keyword or phrase to look for across the board's job posts.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Optional. Keep only posts whose location or office matches this text, e.g. 'New York' or 'Remote'.
parameters.name: location

parameters.name: limit

returns.description: Job posts matching the query. Descriptions are omitted from hits; 'searched' is how many posts were scanned.

description: Read any company's public Greenhouse job board: list and search its open roles, pull a job post's full description and application questions, and browse its departments, offices, and prospect sections. Read-only and keyless, so no Greenhouse account or API key is required.
